text: Thulh Mir Rukan Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Thulh Mir Rukan Type: Archaeological Site - Buddhist Province: Sindh District: Shaheed Benazirabad Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 5th - 6th Century CE Description: The early history of the Thul is shrouded in obscurity. It is said that a king who had no son wanted to preserve his name was advised by his council of Ministers to erect this tower. This is a solid cylindrical structure like a Buddhist stupa tapering at top. It is constructed with a brick casing about 18 m high standing over a square base of 20 m on each side. This could be a Buddhist stupa constructed during the Rai dynasty of Sindh (5th-6th centuries CE).
